info.description: The buyers-agent product API, version 1. Resources are agency-scoped. Lists take `limit` (1 to 200) and `offset` and return `X-Total-Count`. Creates accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Errors are `{detail, code}`. When tokens are configured, send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
